results.question: How does the share of renewables in electricity generation in recent years compare with what is needed by 2030 and 2050 under the 1.5 degree C scenario?
results.answer_preview: In recent years, renewables have been around 28% of electricity generation. Under the 1.5°C scenario, that share needs to rise to 68% by 2030 and 91% by 2050. The same source also notes the broader power mix shift, with renewables rising from 28% in 2020 to 91% in 2050.
